name: basic-widget
label: Hello Frankfurt
author: Esri
description: This is a basic widget based on the simple widget example that comes with the installation. It includes an example of how to use the config file, and it includes a placeholder SVG icon. It intentionally does not include the following so you can use this to start from scratch: i18n translations, a Settings panel, unit tests. See the documentation for more information on how to implement these features.
